summary: AkzoNobel filed a Form 6-K on October 5, 2026, confirming binding agreements to sell its Decorative Paints operations across seven Asia-Pacific countries to Nippon Paint for approximately $1.35 billion (EUR 1.20 billion), implying a 21x EV/FY25 EBITDA multiple. Net cash proceeds are expected around $1 billion. The deals mark the end of AkzoNobel's Asia Decorative Paints portfolio review following prior India and Pakistan sales. Regulatory approvals are pending; closing is expected mid-2027, with Indonesia separately in late 2026. The company now focuses on closing its merger with Axalta.
